Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Nature & food

bell pepper noun

also sweet pepper, red pepper

modern

capsicum, capsicī n.

noun, second declension

pepper of the genus Capsicum

A modern botanical/lexical term; the reference does not fix all its stem quantities.

Other words

  • capsicum dulce — sweet or bell pepper

    also used · modern · M-O

  • capsicum rubrum — red pepper

    also used · our formation

  • piperītis, piperītidis f. — bell pepper; the fresh pepper

    noun, third declension · also used · modern · Traupman 71; Plīn. NH XX 174

    Used in the libellī: Traupman 71 applies it to the fresh Capsicum, and the series follows him (Epp. VI–VII). Ancient piperītis (Pliny) names a different plant, a peppery cress or pepperwort (Plīn. NH XX 174).

Examples

  • Capsicum rubrum secā et sēmina exime.

    Cut the red pepper and remove the seeds.composed

See also pepper, chilli pepper, paprika.
